data.name: kpti_0001_title
data.value: cutLength parameter may be too large

data.name: kpti_0001_message_format
data.value: This value is usually no greater than 1. Did you mean 1 / {0}?

data.name: kpti_0001_description
data.value: The cutLength parameter passed to CutEventToLinear/CutEventsInRange is greater than 1 and may be missing a reciprocal operation.

data.name: kpti_0002_message_format
data.value: This value is usually not equal to 1. Did you mean a fraction or the reciprocal of a value?

data.name: kpti_0002_description
data.value: The cutLength parameter passed to CutEventToLinear/CutEventsInRange equals 1 and may not be the intended cut length.

data.name: kpte_0001_title
data.value: Tolerance parameter may be too large

data.name: kpte_0001_message_format
data.value: Tolerance parameters are percentages. The value {0} is too large; did you mean {0} / 100?

data.name: kpte_0001_description
data.value: Tolerance parameters are percentages. Values greater than or equal to 100 can make parent-line unbinding results unpredictable.

data.name: kpti_0003_title
data.value: Tolerance parameter may be too small

data.name: kpti_0003_message_format
data.value: Tolerance parameters are percentages. The value {0} is too small and may cause the final result to consume a large amount of memory; did you mean {0} * 100?

data.name: kpti_0003_description
data.value: Tolerance parameters are percentages. Values smaller than 0.01 may generate many events and consume excessive memory.

data.name: kptr_0001_message_format
data.value: Adaptive sampling uses a tolerance of 0, which may incur extra performance cost. If you intend to disable tolerance behavior, use the regular unbinder instead.

data.name: kptr_0001_description
data.value: An adaptive sampling tolerance of 0 may incur extra performance cost. Use the regular unbinder without tolerance parameters to disable tolerance behavior.
